tagline: Circle anything on screen: search, translate, ask AI, snip. Free, private, Windows and Linux
outcome: One key over any app gives search, in-place translation, an AI answer or a snip, offline first, with nothing leaving the PC unless the user asks.

users: People who search, translate or ask AI about what is on their screen
Players who want games translated in place
northStar.problem: Circle to Search and Lens are phone-first, online and tied to one company; desktop users get scattered tools.
nonGoals: No macOS until the owner has a Mac
constraints: Windows 10/11 and Linux (X11 + Wayland) from the first design
Offline by default; online only when the user chooses it
One native binary, light on RAM and CPU

waiting.recommended: Settings v2 + the app-wide look + the Snip widget per mode, one canvas round
